ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - AdvancedRun Suspicious Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of AdvancedRun utility in the context of the TrustedInstaller, SYSTEM, Local Service or Network Service accounts

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/EXEFilename.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/CommandLine.*")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/RunAs\\ 8\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/RunAs\\ 4\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/RunAs\\ 10\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/RunAs\\ 11\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX("\\/RunAs\\ 8$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\/RunAs\\ 4$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\/RunAs\\ 10$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\/RunAs\\ 11$"))))
